name: WHATIF Rewards
description: WHATIF Rewards (WHATIFR) is a community-driven ERC-20 token built on the Ethereum blockchain, with a total supply of 420 billion tokens. Designed to reward early adopters and incentivize participation, WHATIFR offers innovative staking opportunities, high-yield rewards, and long-term value through transparent and decentralized tokenomics. With liquidity locked and a focus on fairness, WHATIFR aims to empower its holders while fostering a robust, trust-driven ecosystem.
